name: revise chapter
description: Judge whether one revision pass addresses every editorial request while keeping the chapter's events.

state.chapter: Mara climbed the stairs. She was very afraid. At the top, the lamp had gone out, and something below the water opened its eyes.
requests: Show Mara's fear through what she does instead of stating it.
Name the lighthouse: it is Saint Elmo's Light.

context.title: The Keeper of Saint Elmo's Light
context.premise: A young lighthouse keeper discovers that the light she tends keeps something in the sea asleep.

expected.description: The result says the revision is done. Its chapter still has Mara climbing to a dark lamp while something below the water wakes, shows her fear through her actions rather than saying she was afraid, and names the lighthouse Saint Elmo's Light.

state.chapter: Mara climbs Saint Elmo's Light to find the lamp out; her fear shows in what she does; something below the water opens its eyes.
The supply boat came on Tuesday. Captain Orrin handed Mara a crate and a letter. He left quickly.
requests: Give Captain Orrin one line of dialogue that hints he knows what lives in the sea.
Say what is in the crate.

context.title: The Keeper of Saint Elmo's Light
context.premise: A young lighthouse keeper discovers that the light she tends keeps something in the sea asleep.

expected.description: The result says the revision is done. Its chapter still has the supply boat arrive and Captain Orrin hand Mara a crate and a letter before leaving quickly, gives Orrin a line of dialogue hinting that he knows what lives in the sea, and says what the crate holds.

state.chapter: The supply boat arrives; Orrin hands over a crate whose contents are named and a letter, hints at what lives in the sea, and leaves quickly.
